method: Read content.json brief and PDF extracted text
Opened all twelve page PNGs individually using view_image
Checked PDF page boxes and embedded font metadata with PyMuPDF and pdffonts
Cross-read drawing_checks.json, native_drawings_audit.json and native_drawings_reload.json for dimensional coherence

After regeneration, reopened all twelve revised PNGs and rechecked final PDF page sizes/font metadata; verified page 10 correction and whole-document absence of this class of dimension/caption collision.
method_scope.scope: Independent PDF presentation, contract, font, caption and dimension-placement review; no CAD mutation or manufacturing validation. Native reload success is corroborated by existing reports, not independently rerun by this reviewer.

checks.embedded_font: YFJGAP+TsangerJinKai02; CID TrueType, embedded/subset/Unicode mapping present
checks.preserve_boundaries: Launch console, original base and controller, shortened original-kit cables, approximation limits and component index represented.

findings.element: Top summary and bottom explanatory paragraphs
findings.evidence: Bottom paragraphs repeat the top summary and the same unit/approximation/explosion boilerplate across sheets.
findings.impact: Editorial repetition adds little information; text remains legible and within page boundaries.
findings.requested_fix: Optional future editorial pass: consolidate shared notes and retain page-specific interpretation.

verdict: Accepted for PDF presentation and contract scope. All 12 revised pages inspected; page 10 blocking defect resolved. One nonblocking editorial repetition observation remains. This review does not certify manufacturing accuracy or independently rerun native CAD reload.

resolved_findings.evidence: Dimension arrow and label appear above upper-right base illustration; both extension lines descend through the base illustration and its caption to the lower-right USB-C detail. drawing_checks.json identifies this as sheet 10, view USBCPlug, label_position [302.5,17.4].
resolved_findings.impact: Ambiguous dimension attribution and collision with unrelated view/caption.
resolved_findings.requested_fix: Move dimension arrow/label into lower-right USB-C detail panel above its geometry and below base caption; regenerate native sheets, PDF and page images.
resolved_findings.resolution: Revised page 10 places ≈8.3 immediately above the lower-right USB-C detail, below the base caption. Extension lines remain within the detail panel and no longer cross the base or its caption. Confirmed independently by opening revised page 10.
